Sample.evidence_source: The following study, based on interviews with 52 men who engaged in suicidal behaviour, is part of an attempt to explore the background circumstances and motivations involved in the suicidal behaviour. A qualitative methodology, based on in-depth, unstructured interviews, was chosen as the most appropriate way to explore these issues. A consecutive sample of 52 men aged between eighteen and thirty years was interviewed as soon as possible after a suicidal action.

Country.evidence_source: The sample was drawn from three hospitals in the general Dublin area.
